name: Aurora VA
explanation: A polyphonic virtual-analog synthesizer modelled control-for-control on the Clavia Nord Lead 2 (Nord Lead 2 English User Manual v1.0, read cover to cover). Two oscillators: OSC1 (sine / triangle / sawtooth / pulse) and OSC2 (triangle / sawtooth / pulse / noise, with a Semitone coarse tune of +/-60 semitones and a Fine tune within a semitone, plus a Keyboard-Track switch that frees OSC2 from the keyboard). Settings for both oscillators: linear FM (OSC2 modulates OSC1), Ring Modulation, hard Oscillator Sync (OSC2 slaved to OSC1, combinable with Ring Mod), a shared Pulse Width, and an OSC1<->OSC2 Mix. The classic Nord multimode Filter with five types (LP 12dB, LP 24dB, HP 24dB, BP, Notch+LP 12dB), Frequency, Resonance, a bipolar Envelope Amount fed by a dedicated four-stage ADSR filter envelope, a Velocity switch, a three-step Keyboard Track (1/3, 2/3, full) and a Distortion switch. A full ADSR Amplifier envelope with output Gain. LFO 1 (soft-random / square / triangle / sawtooth / random, Rate and Amount, routable to FM / OSC1+2 / OSC2 / Filter / Pulse-Width). LFO 2 / Arpeggiator: LFO 2 modulation (triangle, routable to OSC1+2 / Amp / Filter) plus an Up / Down / Up&Down / Random / Echo arpeggiator with 1-4 octave range and Hold. A Modulation Envelope (Attack, Decay, bipolar Amount, routable to FM / Pulse-Width / OSC2 pitch). Performance: Modulation-Wheel destination (Morph / LFO1 / OSC2 / FM / Filter), Poly / Legato / Mono play modes, Unison, Portamento with Auto (legato-glide) mode, Octave Shift, Pitch-Stick with Bend Range, Master Tune and Master Volume. Switch groups are bit-packed into single host parameters; the panel decodes and shows every individual switch. The Morph is implemented as a mod-wheel performance macro; Percussion Kits, Performances, Keyboard Split and PCMCIA storage are host concerns and out of scope.
